issues.description: Subroutine 'set_pixel' calling-convention mismatch: the problem statement (Teilaufgabe b) requires that only EAX may be clobbered by set_pixel — "Außer dem Register eax dürfen keine anderen Registerinhalte verändert werden" — (problem_statement.md). The template's comment at the calculation TODO instructs students to "save all registers you modify except eax, ebx and esi", which effectively allows EBX and ESI to be modified without being preserved (template/pixel.asm). The provided solution preserves modified registers (push/pop ebx, esi, edx) and therefore follows the problem statement. This contradiction (template vs. problem statement) can confuse students about which registers must be saved/restored when implementing set_pixel and may lead to incorrect implementations that violate the intended calling convention.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template comment with the problem statement's calling convention. Update the TODO comment near the position-calculation to state explicitly that set_pixel must not modify any registers except EAX (i.e., EBX, ECX, EDX, ESI, EDI, etc. must be preserved across the call), and instruct students to push/pop any registers they need to use. Alternatively, explicitly document the allowed/clobbered registers (calling convention) in the problem statement and the template so both artifacts match.
